s: Beezeh tepillot noseim kappayim ubo b' seipim: en nesiat kappayim ella beshacharit umusap uneila beyom sheyyesh bo neila kegon beyom hakkippurim, abal lo bemincha, mippene shehashshikrut metzuya beotah shaa veshemma yihyeh hakkohen shikkor. Vegazeru bemincha shel yom hakkippurim ushear taanit tzibbur sheyyesh bahen neila kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tqa"t ap al pi sheen bahem chashash shikrut, gezera mishshum mincha shel shear yamim, lepi shebbeyom sheyyesh bo neila mitpalelim mincha beod hayyom gadol kede lehatchil neila qodem sheqiat hachamma umitchallepet hi bemincha shel shear yamim, shehayu nohagim lehitpallel beod hayyom gadol mippene otam sherotzim leekol achar kak, sheasur leekol qodem tepillat hammincha kemo sheyyitbaer siman rl"b. Abal betaanit sheen bahem neila, hoil utepillat hammincha hu samuk lishqiat hachamma — hi doma litpillat neila veenah mitchallepet bemincha shel shear hayyamim, lepikak yesh bah nesiat kappayim:

Kohen sheabar veala laddukan beyom hakkippurim bemincha, kevan shehaddabar yadua sheen sham shikrut — hare zeh nose kappayv veen moridin oto, mippene hachashad shello yomru pasul hu ulekak horiduhu. Velaken nohagim bimdinot ellu lomar "elohenu velohe abotenu barekenu ku'" beyom hakkippurim bemincha, ap al pi sheen omerim ella bizman harauy linsiat kappayim, mikkol maqom hoil veim ala lo yered venose kappayv — niqra qetzat rauy linsiat kappayim:
